title: Legacy Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long-lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
  1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
  2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender-based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
  3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post-tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your profile

  • Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations: Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Legacy Development
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organizing, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post-event reporting.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

The Partnership Development Manager will be responsible for driving sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets. The role requires deep market knowledge and a robust network in the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Senior Partnership Development Manager, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your Profile / Qualifications

  • High professional standards, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship-building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.

  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Partnership Development Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The position

The Partnership Development Manager will be responsible for driving sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets. The role requires deep market knowledge and a robust network in the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Senior Partnership Development Manager, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Source, qualify, and engage potential sponsors, securing meetings and presenting tailored partnership proposals to major regional and international brands.
  • Develop bespoke sponsorship packages that address the unique needs and objectives of prospective partners.
  • Lead negotiations through to successful acquisition, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s commercial guidelines and values.
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Establish and nurture long-term relationships with key sponsor prospects, ensuring continuity and value beyond the tournament.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Sales Analyst FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.
  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.
  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.
  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.
  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.
  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)
  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship
  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização
  • Conhecimento de Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, Push).
  • Experiência com CI/CD mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps).
  • Noções de observabilidade e monitoramento em apps.
  • Experiência com app em produção (mesmo que em menor escala).

Job Description

The position

This role will ensure the seamless planning and execution of supply chain operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ tournament. Will be responsible for material planning, operations planning, procedures and liaison with other Functional areas.

Key responsibilities

  • Logistics Planning: Design and implement end-to-end supply chain strategies for host city venues.
  • Operational Control: Coordinate warehouse management, material handling, and asset tracking (e.g., equipment for stadiums and training sites).
  • Stakeholder Management: Work with Host Cities, Official Logistics Service Providers (LSPs), and FIFA functional areas to align on requirements.
  • Risk Mitigation: Maintain risk registers and develop contingency plans for logistical challenges.
  • Reporting: Monitor KPIs for logistics, policies and procedures

Your profile

  • Education: Engineering, Administration, Economics, International relations or other related areas.
  • Experience: minimum 5 years experience in material planning, logistics and procurement.
  • Collaborative mindset, adaptable and willing to work to tight and changing timelines.
  • Proficient in analytical thinking and data skills.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude, patience, persistence, and determination.
  • Experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in IT tools (excel and others)
  • Excelent knowledge in AI
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department

Department: Events & Entertainment

Location

Location: Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train-the-Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master\'s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

About The Team/role

You will join, as an individual contributor, the newly established Commercial Quality team within our Commercial Enablement structure at 99Food, an operation committed to scaling high-performance field sales with the right skills, consistency, and impact. Your mission is to act as the "quality gatekeeper", monitoring everything that may go wrong in the sales operation, from skill execution to system usage and process adherence, and ensuring rapid diagnosis and correction. This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Conduct audits across the commercial journey, observing field visits, CRM/system logs, demos, emails, and adherence to playbooks, to identify deviations and opportunities.
  • Manage with the team, frequent field visits alongside Business Developers to observe live execution, assess coaching needs, and validate actual vs. documented behavior.
  • Analyze usage patterns in CRMs and other commercial tools to detect gaps, underutilization, or misuse, feeding insights back into training, KB, and process improvement.
  • Act as a guardian of excellence: monitor compliance with playbooks, process flow, KB, and use of tools, and ensure alignment for every BD interaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Operations, and Tech teams to translate QA findings into enhancements, improving Knowledge Base, training modules, workflows, and system improvements.
  • Produce recurring reports on QA insights, emerging gaps, trends, and prioritized recommendations for rapid corrective action and strategic evolution.
  • Coach and mentor QA Specialists, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, consistency, and data-based quality execution.
  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O nosso verde é plural e sempre acolherá todas as pessoas!

Nossa missão é conquistar novos clientes de forma ativa e consultiva através do canal telefônico. Para isso, fazemos um atendimento personalizado com o objetivo de entregar as melhores experiências para o cliente. description:
Overview

Faça sua mágica acontecer conosco. Você está pronto para explorar, quebrar barreiras e fazer novas descobertas? Sabemos que você tem grandes planos — e nós também! Mundialmente, adoramos inovar em ciência e tecnologia para agregar valor à vida das pessoas com nossas soluções de Healthcare, Life Science e Electronics. Juntos, sonhamos alto e somos obstinados por cuidar da nossa rica mistura de pessoas, clientes, pacientes e do planeta. Estamos sempre em busca de mentes curiosas que se veem imaginando o inimaginável conosco.

Unidos As One for Patients: nosso propósito na área de Cuidados com a Saúde é ajudar a criar, melhorar e prolongar vidas. Desenvolvemos medicamentos, dispositivos inteligentes e tecnologias inovadoras em áreas terapêuticas como Oncologia, Neurologia e Fertilidade. Nossas equipes trabalham juntas nos seis continentes com muita paixão e curiosidade para auxiliar os pacientes em todas as etapas da vida. Unir-se à nossa equipe de Cuidados com a Saúde significa fazer parte de uma cultura de trabalho diversificada, inclusiva e flexível, com grandes oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e evolução profissional por todo o mundo.

O Seu Papel

  • Gestão de Desvios e CAPA: Realizar a coleta e análise de dados para abertura de desvios, controle de mudanças e gerenciamento de CAPAs (Ações Corretivas e Preventivas).
  • Investigações Técnicas: Liderar investigações de eventos e desvios (menores, maiores e críticos), identificando causas raízes e propondo soluções eficazes.
  • Auditoria e Compliance: Realizar a revisão de trilhas de auditoria e participar ativamente da preparação para auditorias externas e inspeções sanitárias.
  • Monitoramento de Produção: Acompanhar os processos produtivos em tempo real, garantindo o estrito cumprimento das normas vigentes e Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF/GMP).
  • Melhoria Contínua: Liderar pequenos projetos de otimização, auxiliando a coordenação no alcance dos KPIs (indicadores de performance) e na redução de reclamações de mercado.
  • Gestão Documental: Assegurar a atualização constante de SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão), PPs e demais documentos técnicos da área.
  • Representação Técnica: Realizar apresentações em reuniões multidisciplinares e responder tecnicamente por suas atividades perante autoridades sanitárias.

Quem é Você

  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo (Farmácia, Eng. Química, Eng. Produção).
  • Conhecimento Normativo: Domínio de Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF/GMP) e legislações sanitárias vigentes.
  • Inglês Avançado.
  • Experiências relevantes nas áreas de Qualidade, Produção, Tecnologia Farmacêutica e indústrias Farmacêuticas.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Capacidade de investigar desvios complexos e analisar dados estatísticos com raciocínio lógico.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de realizar entregas com responsabilidade e tomar decisões técnicas seguras dentro de sua alçada.
  • Comunicação: Habilidade para relatar cenários técnicos de forma clara, objetiva e sem ambiguidades.

O que oferecemos

Somos mentes curiosas que vêm de uma ampla gama de origens, perspectivas e experiências de vida. Acreditamos que essa variedade impulsiona a excelência e a inovação, fortalecendo nossa capacidade de liderar em ciência e tecnologia. Estamos comprometidos em criar acesso e oportunidades para todos se desenvolverem e crescerem no seu próprio ritmo. Junte-se a nós para construir uma cultura de inclusão e pertencimento que impacta milhões e capacita todos a defender o progresso humano!

Candidate-se agora e torne-se parte de uma equipe dedicada a Despertar a Descoberta e Elevar a Humanidade!

This is a hands-on role where you’ll balance leadership with execution — mentoring your team, troubleshooting complex issues, and building scalable processes to maintain our 1-minute average first response time. You’ll work across our multi-product ecosystem, supporting both SaaS and mobile experiences, and help ensure smooth integrations as we expand into new product lines. If you love building structure from scratch, guiding others, and partnering across teams to make new technology successful, this is your chance to have an outsized impact.

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to triage, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across SaaS and mobile products.

Bonus Points

  • You’re comfortable using tools like Postman, Zendesk, and FullStory for debugging and analysis.
  • You’ve worked with non-technical customers in industrial, logistics, or distribution sectors.

Why Join Canals

  • We\'re profitable: stability without the chaos of venture pivots.
  • Real-world impact: your work improves global supply chains, saving customers time and reducing waste.
  • Strong engineering culture: we invest in quality and documentation to keep moving fast sustainably.

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open‑source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high‑performing team.

Location

  • Conduct one‑on‑one meetings with team members

  • Interact with a vibrant community

  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional Python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programmes to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

title: HPC Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

HPC Engineer Role

HPC is an important and technically challenging compute domain, with specialised tooling and a very high expectation of precision, efficiency and automation. This role is for a software engineer to join our HPC team to deliver an outstanding HPC experience – from bare metal to public cloud – as part of the broader Ubuntu platform. We are looking for a range of skills and experience, and will work on everything from the kernel to Debian packaging, but the heart of our effort will be Python software development for automation of key software in the HPC sphere. Our focus is on delivering a world class experience for the operation of the HPC cluster itself. You will be part of the team that delivers charms that deploy and manage the HPC cluster and provide HPC software packages.

To succeed in this application you must be outstanding at maths and sciences, have built high quality software, have learned about open source ideally by working on it directly, and be looking for an engineering role with a company that makes mission‑critical products for the global market. You should also be familiar with the open source environment, and want to build products in partnership with a community. Ideally, you should have some experience of high performance computing environments and a desire to unlock HPC for the world.

For this role you must have experience with Python. Experience in HPC environments is a strong advantage. Familiarity with HPC hardware and software is also a strong advantage – delivering great experiences with Infiniband, RDMA, CUDA, MPI, Slurm, Lustre, Singularity and related technologies will be central to this team’s work. It will also be advantageous to have experience with Docker image design and operations, and public cloud image design and operations.

Location

  • Contribuição para a eficiência operacional dos processos de RH, mensurável em horas de trabalho economizadas

Sobre a empresa

Somos uma empresa em crescimento , especializada em soluções inovadoras para gestão de talentos e processos de RH. Nosso foco é criar ambientes de trabalho inclusivos, que valorizam o desenvolvimento profissional contínuo e a experiência do colaborador. Com uma equipe colaborativa e ágil, buscamos talentos que queiram crescer junto conosco e contribuir para a transformação digital do setor.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Produtos Sênior | Marketing
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir com autonomia o desenvolvimento e inovação de novos produtos, transformando ideias em lançamentos de sucesso — end to end
  • Se conectar com tendências, mercado e comportamento do consumidor identificando oportunidades
  • Construir estratégias de portfólio conectadas com o negócio para fortalecer nossas marcas visando impulsionar crescimento.
  • Realizar apresentações para a alta diretoria garantindo story-telling coeso e persuasivo.
  • Criar e acompanhar briefings de produto, embalagem e matérias primas junto a fornecedores e parceiros.
  • Conduzir projetos de forma integrada com as áreas internas, garantindo alinhamento de entregas, prazos, custos e margens nos lançamentos.
  • Executar o calendário de lançamentos com visão de prioridades, autonomia e colaboração.
  • Construir a identidade das marcas, redigindo e revisando textos de rotulagem e materiais de apoio.
  • Monitorar a performance do portfólio, reportando análises e propondo melhorias contínuas.

Sobre a Duty Cosméticos

Nascemos em 2019 no Rio de Janeiro, e acreditamos que usar cosméticos vai além de um ato de autocuidado: é um meio de se expressar, se empoderar e se amar. Por isso, desenvolvemos os melhores cuidados e experiências de forma ética, sustentável e acessível da fórmula às embalagens. Nossas marcas destinadas ao varejo são Dabelle e Eico.

Nosso time está espalhado por todo o país e atualmente temos a sede no Rio, além de escritórios em São Paulo e Recife. Valorizamos a nossa gente diariamente proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho pautado em nossos valores. Acreditamos que todos possuem um papel de extrema importância em nossa trajetória. Somos uma empresa, mas somos feitos de pessoas.

Desde 2022 somos certificados como uma excelente empresa para se trabalhar pela GPTW e em 2024 e 2025 fomos ranqueados como uma das Melhores Empresas para se Trabalhar no RJ. Este ano, já enquadrados como empresa de grande porte, seguimos nos preocupando com nossas práticas de gestão de pessoas com o nosso compromisso em sempre melhorar nossa forma de fazer negócios para o nosso colaborador, cliente e consumidor.

Sobre a Área

A área de Desenvolvimento de Produtos é a área que une o Marketing com a área de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento para criar e lançar novos produtos cosméticos das nossas marcas, analisando tendências de mercado e o comportamento do consumidor alinhando o desenvolvimento com suas necessidades e desejos aos objetivos da empresa.

Sobre a Vaga

Se você é criativo, dinâmico, proativo, organizado e conectado com tendências, essa vaga é pra você! Buscamos um novo talento para atuar no desenvolvimento e inovação de produtos das nossas marcas liderando projetos com protagonismo, construindo estratégias de lançamentos, apresentações gerenciais e muito mais!

Quer fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente?

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Marketing, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência no segmento de cosméticos e beleza.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office - PowerPoint avançado.
  • Domínio de redação e narrativa de produto, com clareza na comunicação oral e escrita para construção de rótulos, claims e materiais de apoio.
  • Experiência em gerir projetos de produto com autonomia e iniciativa - mandatório

  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco para cuidar de você.

  • Acesso gratuito ao Starbem, focado em saúde mental e bem-estar no ambiente de trabalho.

  • Folga no mês do aniversário para um Happy Day com quem você ama.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos Jr
description:
VEM SER GUARACAMP!

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO

O Analista de RH será um agente de transformação e suporte que atuará dando apoio a atração, desenvolvimento e engajamento dos colaboradores, sendo essencial para manter um quadro de pessoal qualificado e motivado.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Apoio em Processos Seletivos de vagas operacionais: Atuar no ciclo completo de recrutamento e seleção de vagas pontuais em diferentes níveis e áreas, desde a divulgação até a proposta, garantindo o fit cultural dos novos talentos.
  • Conduzir entrevistas de desligamento com profundidade e profissionalismo, analisando os dados coletados para fornecer insumos e insights estratégicos para a liderança, visando a elaboração de planos de ação de retenção de talentos e melhoria contínua do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Realizar o Levantamento de Necessidades de Treinamento (LNT) em parceria com as lideranças, identificando gaps de competências e definindo prioridades de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar a criação, organização e execução de programas de desenvolvimento humano (treinamentos, workshops, mentorias), acompanhando a logística e a avaliação de eficácia para potencializar o desempenho e o crescimento das equipes.
  • Ser o ponto focal e o responsável pelo Endomarketing e Comunicação Interna, elaborando e executando um plano de comunicação coeso e atrativo (e-mails, murais, newsletters, canais internos), mantendo o time informado e engajado.
  • Conduzir rituais, eventos e estratégias de fortalecimento da cultura organizacional e dos valores da empresa, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo, colaborativo e com senso de pertencimento.

HABILIDADES COMPORTAMENTAIS

  1. Relacionamento Interpessoal
  2. Visão Estratégica
  3. Análise crítica
  4. Senso de Inovação e urgência
  5. Comunicação Clara e Eficaz
  6. Organização e Planejamento

title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.

This role entails

  • Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.
  • Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.
  • Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.
  • Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world‑class resource for Data Centre operators and users.
  • Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.
  • Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.
  • Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with you and other teams.

What we are looking for in you

  • Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation
  • Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back‑end roles, or TypeScript, React for front‑end roles.
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques
  • Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal
  • Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP
  • Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)
  • Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.
  • Ideally, experience of large‑scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.
  • Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

  • Demonstrates creativity, foresight, and mature engineering judgment in anticipating and solving engineering problems during the development and application of new and improved products and processes.
  • Establishes best practices that incorporate Reliability, Health, Safety, and Environment concepts to guide others in analysis and design.
  • Evaluates proposed theoretical results to meet design requirements.
  • Serves as a technical expert to other employees to solves complex system equations and develops custom equations to simplify complex problems by using advanced engineering tools.
  • Serves as a technical expert by coaching, developing, and reviewing work from other employees.
  • Possesses excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross- disciplinary teams.
  • Significantly contributes to Halliburton’s Intellectual Property portfolio by delivering innovative and commercially successful solutions.
  • Work across multiple teams located in different countries (Brazil, US, Singapore, India).
  • Work close to the Electrical Engineering team, Systems Engineer, and the Project Manager at the Halliburton Technology Center in Brazil (HBTC).

Qualifications

  • Completion of a master’s or doctoral degree in Electrical Engineering or similar discipline is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • 5 years of experience in R&D.
  • Experience with multidisciplinary teams located in different locations/countries.
  • Experience in design of complex systems solutions including several engineering disciplines for Oil & Gas, mining and/or aerospace industry.
  • Experience in design solutions for subsea applications and well control involving multi disciplines.
  • Experience in design solutions for well intervention applications involving multi disciplines is desirable.
  • Ability to provide guidance and mentoring to more junior engineers as needed.
  • Experience defining requirements and reviewing proposals from third party (manufacturers, vendors, and suppliers).
  • Knowledge of vessels structure and process is desirable.
  • Knowledge and experience in Risk Assessment, FMEA, other reliability tools.
  • Advanced experience with design, simulation, development, implementation, verification, and validation of power electronic based systems/solutions.
  • Troubleshooting of power electronics and proficiency in using lab equipment.
  • Knowledge of communication systems/solutions (data compression and transmission).
  • Advanced working knowledge in electronic circuit design and in commonly used circuit simulators (LTSPICE, PSPICE, etc.) and math tools (Matlab, MathCAD, etc.) applied to embedded systems in harsh environments (O&G, mining or aerospace).
  • Knowledge in power systems demands (Batteries / Recharge / Power management / Passivation / Ramp up / Shut down).

description:
Grupo FIT Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Você é um(a) líder que acelera com visão estratégica, paixão por gente e foco total em performance? No Grupo FIT, o(a) Diretor(a) é o nosso(a) piloto principal na pista, a liderança máxima da operação. É quem garante que as engrenagens rodem com excelência — da gastronomia à cultura, das vendas aos resultados. Com presença ativa nos boxes e olhar atento ao painel de controle, esse(a) profissional comanda múltiplas lojas e marcas, equilibrando agilidade, disciplina e visão de dono. Aqui, liderar é acelerar junto com o time, fazer pit stops estratégicos e manter o motor da operação rodando com alta performance. Se você quer estar no grid de largada de um time que valoriza gente, entrega e atitude, essa vaga é pra você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Diretor de Vendas no Grupo FIT, você terá uma atuação estratégica e multifacetada, garantindo a excelência em todas as pontas da nossa operação. Suas principais responsabilidades e atribuições incluem :

Visão Estratégica e Gestão do Negócio

Liderar operações com múltiplas marcas, formatos e perfis de loja.

Traduzir a estratégia do Grupo FIT em rotinas práticas e metas objetivas.

Apresentar resultados à diretoria com visão analítica, atitude consultiva e foco em escala.

Conduzir análises de DRE, planejamento financeiro e planos de expansão.

Testar e implementar novos formatos operacionais, com foco em crescimento sustentável.

Controle Financeiro e Resultados

Ser responsável direto por DRE, CMV, CMO, headcount e margem operacional das lojas.

Atuar sobre indicadores como produtividade, jornada, ticket médio e custo de mão de obra.

Liderar planos de recuperação de lojas com baixo desempenho.

Transformar KPIs em ações práticas de curto, médio e longo prazo.

Gestão de Pessoas Cultura

Liderar gerentes e líderes operacionais com protagonismo, escuta e foco em desenvolvimento.

Realizar feedbacks, avaliações de desempenho, planos de ação e sucessão.

Sustentar a cultura FIT na prática diária, sendo referência de atitude, disciplina e coerência.

Atuar junto ao time de Gente & Gestão em clima, engajamento e gestão de talentos.

Acompanhar indicadores de turnover, absenteísmo e clima, com planos preventivos.

Excelência Operacional

Estar presente nas unidades, conduzindo rituais de rotina, checklists e acompanhamentos.

Garantir padrões de limpeza, organização e segurança alimentar (conforme ANVISA e auditorias).

Criar e sustentar rotinas sólidas de abertura, acompanhamento e fechamento.

Controlar estoques, validade e perdas com foco em eficiência operacional e CMV saudável.

Gastronomia, Qualidade e Padrão

Atuar em conjunto com líderes de cozinha, nutricionistas e chefs.

Garantir padrão técnico e sensorial : sabor, montagem, tempo e temperatura.

Apoiar testes e lançamentos de cardápio com visão comercial e foco no cliente.

Vendas, Cliente e Marketing

Liderar times com foco em vendas, ticket médio e metas de atendimento.

Trabalhar junto ao marketing em campanhas e ativações locais.

Monitorar NPS, avaliações online e feedbacks de clientes — agindo com rapidez e inteligência.

Ser referência de postura no salão, especialmente em momentos de pico.

Relação com a Diretoria

Manter relacionamento direto com diretores e VP de Vendas, conciliando visões com foco em resultado.

Ser ponte entre o time operacional e a liderança corporativa.

Promover clareza, alinhamento e foco coletivo, sustentando a cultura de dono em todas as camadas.

Relacionamento com Concessionária (Aeroporto)

Manter relacionamento estratégico com a administração do aeroporto, garantindo conformidade com normas e excelência operacional no ambiente aeroportuário.

Análise e Planejamento

Analisar resultados, mapear processos e propor melhorias contínuas.

Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação e projetos de otimização de resultados.

Participar ativamente de reuniões com a diretoria, promovendo alinhamento estratégico e decisões ágeis.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos um profissional com o seguinte perfil e qualificações :

Organizacionais : Disciplina que nos fortalece, Segurança em cada atitude, Gratidão que nos conecta, Vibração que inspira.

Habilidades : Gostar de estar em campo, liderar com presença e transformar desafios em ação. Entender que resultado é reflexo de ritmo, cultura e consistência operacional.

Comportamentais : Comunicação clara e inteligência emocional.

Conhecimentos : Domínio de indicadores financeiros, gestão de pessoas e execução estratégica.

Certificações / Cursos Desejáveis : Formação ou cursos em gestão de negócios, gastronomia, hospitalidade ou áreas correlatas são um diferencial.

Experiência Desejável : Trajetória sólida em operações de varejo, foodservice, hospitalidade ou franquias multiloja.

Local de Atuação : Rio de Janeiro

Salário : R$ 10.000,00

Benefícios : Refeição no local + bônus de performance estratégica.

Turnos : Manhã, tarde ou noite, conforme necessidade da loja.

title: Pessoa Diretora de Parcerias Institucionais e Captação
description:
Overview

A Share People hub , em parceria com o Instituto de Clima e Sociedade (ICS ), busca por Pessoa Diretora de Parcerias Institucionais e Captação , para atuação global, com sede fixa em um dos hubs: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou Brasília .

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a área de Parcerias Institucionais e Captação, assegurando a representação institucional do ICS, bem como um processo eficiente de captação de recursos e prestação de contas, além de uma receita financeira robusta e sustentável do ICS, coordenando a relação com financiadores, incluindo recursos filantrópicos, de fundos climáticos internacionais, de fontes de programas bilaterais e de cooperação ao desenvolvimento, de fontes privadas, entre outras.
  • Definir, coordenar e implementar estratégias de captação e relacionamento com financiadores, doadores e parceiros estratégicos, incluindo recursos filantrópicos, fundos climáticos internacionais, programas bilaterais, cooperação ao desenvolvimento e fontes privadas, além de identificar e desenvolver novas parcerias.
  • Manter relações e coordenação contínua com financiadores do ICS e outras parceiras estratégicas (tais como instituições similares ao ICS operando em outros países), incluindo gerenciar a coordenação de intercâmbio de informações, conhecimento e diálogo, considerando tendências e necessidades de doadores.
  • Supervisionar a preparação de novas propostas, renovações de apoios e relatórios, garantindo elevada qualidade de textos e documentos apresentados a financiadores.
  • Prospectar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de captação de recursos para o ICS (incluindo recursos filantrópicos, fundos climáticos internacionais, programas bilaterais e de cooperação ao desenvolvimento, fontes privadas, entre outras) e desenvolver estratégias para captar e executar tais recursos, contemplando a identificação de arranjos institucionais, potenciais parcerias estratégicas para sua implementação, bem como a elaboração de recomendações e propostas sobre novas formas de captação e execução.
  • Monitorar tendências, prioridades e linhas de financiamento de diferentes fontes, assegurando desenvolvimento constante de recomendações sobre potenciais áreas estratégicas e possíveis considerações operacionais para o ICS.
  • Aprimorar os processos internos de gestão de informação para subsidiar a preparação de propostas e relatórios.
  • Representar a organização em fóruns, eventos e agendas com financiadores, parceiros e iniciativas de cooperação internacional.
  • Co-construir com o departamento programático projetos e narrativas de captação de recursos que respondam às prioridades da organização.
  • Participar ativamente do Grupo Gestor e contribuir para a gestão geral do Instituto.
  • Coordenar as equipes por meio das melhores práticas de gestão de pessoas.

Requisitos

  • Curso superior completo, preferencialmente em Direito, Administração, Ciências Econômicas;
  • Inglês fluente, espanhol será diferencial complementar;
  • Experiência mínima de 12 anos em cargos correlatos de liderança na captação de recursos, em particular relacionados a mudanças do clima, seja no terceiro setor, em agência de cooperação ou em filantropias;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas e processos;
  • Experiência comprovada em preparação de propostas para financiamento, gestão e relação com doadores e financiadores, gestão de parcerias, relatórios e gestão de fundos;
  • Conhecimento profundo de requerimentos, critérios, indicadores e linha vertical de fundos climáticos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais, conforme demanda.
  • Desejável conhecimento com gestão de monitoramento e regranting;

Sobre o ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Priorizamos medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, especialmente para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é doar para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

title: Regulatory Affairs (Pharma) Expert
description:
Overview

At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our Values

Our values guide how we work:

  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation

Responsibilities

Your Responsibilities:

  • Lead global regulatory strategy and submissions across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
  • Plan, author, and review eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
  • Represent Regulatory Affairs on cross-functional teams, providing guidance on regional requirements and development pathways
  • Provide strategic input on CMC, clinical, and nonclinical documentation for global compliance
  • Coordinate electronic submissions with Regulatory Operations using Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart, and global gateways (FDA ESG, CESP, BfArM, Health Canada, ANVISA)
  • Monitor global regulations and communicate key changes to stakeholders
  • Prepare regulatory correspondence, briefing packages, and materials for health authority meetings
  • Manage post-approval commitments, renewals, and lifecycle activities
  • Review labeling, advertising, and promotional materials for regulatory compliance
  • Maintain relationships with health authorities and industry peers
  • Partner with Quality, Clinical, Nonclinical, and Manufacturing to align regulatory documentation
  • Improve regulatory processes and support audits, inspections, and other regulatory projects

Your Profile

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or related field required; advanced degree (M.S., Ph.D., Pharm.D.) preferred
  • RAC certification or equivalent highly desirable; ongoing professional development in global regulatory strategy is a plus
  • 8–10 years of global regulatory affairs experience in drug development and lifecycle management across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
  • Strong hands-on experience with global eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
  • Proven success in global registration strategy and interactions with FDA, EMA, Health Canada, ANVISA, NMPA, and other authorities
  • Deep knowledge of ICH guidelines, regional regulations, and global submission standards
  • Proficiency with regulatory information/publishing systems (e.g., Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart) and electronic gateways
  • Broad understanding of CMC, clinical, and nonclinical regulatory requirements
  • Strong project management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a global matrix, handle multiple complex projects, and adapt to evolving regulatory requirements

Our Offer for you

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.

  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
About the Role


The Service Provider will be providing QC services at WAG (Water Alternate Gas) manifolds worksite based in Rio, Brazil with frequent travel within to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG Brasil. You will be responsible to ensure that Contractor (CTR) supplies WAG Manifold and Foundations on-time as per the clients HSE policies and with satisfactory & required level of quality.


The Service Provider will liaise with CPY Subsea HSE Lead, CPY Quality Lead, CPY Materials & Welding Lead and CPY Delivery Lead.



HSE and Compliance



  • Fully comply with site security, health and safety instructions, stay vigilant and maintain continuous awareness of hazards and surroundings.

  • Will be accountable for demonstrating, individually, an exemplary behaviour regarding HSE rules & requirements, including trainings, and enforcing HSE execution decisions/directions taken by CPY Subsea HSE Lead.

  • Report any issue/anomalies (using system in place in the facility) and to make use of TOTAL STOP WORK policy as necessary.

  • Ensure that risk assessments are performed as and when necessary, that management of change is adhered to and that tool-box talks are conducted efficiently.

  • Adopt and demonstrate exemplary behaviour regarding Company Ethics and “Code of Conduct” policy and promote the re-enforcement of the Anti-Corruption Program.


WORK TASKS


The Service holder will be responsible to control that the work performed by CTR and sub-CTR is in line with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations in terms of Quality.


For all these tasks, the incumbent will be requested:



  • To conduct thorough inspections of welds and welding processes to ensure compliance with applicable WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and specifications, have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have extensive inspection knowledge and experience (min 10 years) in CRA materials such as Super duplex (Pipe/Forging and HIPPED), Inconel 625 and LAS (F22)

  • To have excellent inspection experience in buttering, overlay and girth welding of Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables

  • To utilize advanced inspection techniques including visual, ultrasonic, Phase Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT), magnetic particle, Liquid penetrant Inspection and radiographic testing to assess weld quality as per ASME/DNV code requirements

  • To have ability to interpret welding procedure specifications (WPS) and procedure qualification records (PQR) to validate conformance at site during production

  • To have the ability to perform inspection on incoming production materials against requirements and mill certificates

  • To participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and development of corrective action plans in collaboration with project welding engineer and site production teams

  • To identify and raise subsequent comments highlight deviations, unacceptable or unjustified quality issues related but not limited to Welding that could affect SPS equipment during fabrication, installation, and production at site

  • To prepare detailed inspection reports and documentation for compliance on weekly basis

  • To collaborate with Company Site Rep and CPY material engineer on any welding/NDT/material issues at site

  • To stop the work in case of non-conformity and re-assess the situation before resuming To discuss with contractor/sub-contractors in case of issues/unconformity during the control program, to look for acceptable solutions in order not to penalize the delivery schedule but still fulfilling the quality standards set by the contract

  • To ensure that unconformities are driven towards closure in a timely manner (i.e. without impacting the delivery schedule)

  • To follow up site welding activities and provide feedback to project team

  • To participate to COMPANY and contractor audits and follow up closure of identified issues


About You


You are a highly experienced welding and quality professional with a strong background in subsea structures and WAG manifolds. You bring more than 15 years of hands-on experience in welding inspection, with deep technical knowledge of welding processes, materials, and offshore fabrication requirements.


You hold a recognized Welding Inspector certification such as CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2 (or equivalent) and are certified to Level 3 in multiple Non-Destructive Testing methods, including Ultrasonic Testing (UT/PAUT), Radiography (RT), and Dye Penetrant Inspection (DPI).


You are confident in interpreting complex engineering drawings, technical specifications, and welding documentation, and you are known for your strong analytical skills and ability to investigate root causes and resolve challenging quality issues in fast-paced project environments.


You communicate clearly and professionally in English, with additional language skills in Portuguese or French considered an advantage.
